A SMALL EXPERIMENT

One sensor is not the whole picture.

A synthetic example: the vehicle travels 100 m. Change the wheel-distance error and see why a reference point or other measurement can matter.

EXAMPLE DISTANCE100 m
WHEEL ESTIMATE100 m
KNOWN EXAMPLE REFERENCE100 m

Arithmetic illustration, not a positioning algorithm. Real systems estimate uncertainty and combine measurements; a reference update is not a universal guarantee of exact position.
